in_hebrew.name: על-כן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Also' is derived from the Hebrew words 'al' (and) and 'ken' (therefore, furthermore, also). It is used to signify continuation or addition to a previous statement or action.

in_greek.meaning: but, however, on the contrary, also
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Also' is derived from the Greek word 'allá' (but, however, on the contrary, also). It is used to introduce a contrast or alternative to the previous statement or action.
